mapper.sql: aggregate_scope AS aggregateScope, detail_scope AS detailScope, photo_scope AS photoScope, leaderboard_scope AS leaderboardScope, revision, DATE_FORMAT(updated_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s.%f') AS updatedAt
mapper.select: SELECT FROM member_progress_privacy WHERE member_id = #{memberId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO member_progress_privacy(member_id, aggregate_scope, detail_scope, photo_scope, leaderboard_scope, revision, updated_at) VALUES (#{memberId}, #{aggregateScope}, #{detailScope}, #{photoScope}, #{leaderboardScope}, 1, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6)) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE aggregate_scope = VALUES(aggregate_scope), detail_scope = VALUES(detail_scope), photo_scope = VALUES(photo_scope), leaderboard_scope = VALUES(leaderboard_scope), revision = revision + 1, updated_at = GREATEST(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6), DATE_ADD(updated_at, INTERVAL 1 MICROSECOND))
mapper.sql: aggregate_scope AS aggregateScope, detail_scope AS detailScope, board_enabled AS boardEnabled, revision, DATE_FORMAT(updated_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s.%f') AS updatedAt
mapper.select: SELECT FROM im_channel_progress_privacy WHERE channel_id = #{channelId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO im_channel_progress_privacy(channel_id, aggregate_scope, detail_scope, board_enabled, revision, updated_at, update_by) VALUES (#{channelId}, #{aggregateScope}, 'SELF', 1, 1, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6), #{operator}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE aggregate_scope = VALUES(aggregate_scope), revision = revision + 1, updated_at = GREATEST(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6), DATE_ADD(updated_at, INTERVAL 1 MICROSECOND)), update_by = VALUES(update_by)
